newsitem.title: USA: PHP Healthcare to pursue "blocked" payments.
newsitem.headline: PHP Healthcare to pursue "blocked" payments.

text.p: PHP Healthcare Corp said Monday it will pursue payments of $18.9 million it says is owed to it by the District of Columbia.

The company said it recognized a third quarter charge of $9.8 million to establish a reserve for certain Medicaid receivables due from the District of Columbia, principally for services provided during the years 1992 through 1994 at its health maintenance organization subsidiary, D.C. Chartered Health Plan.

For several years the company said it talked with the District regarding these amounts. That process, the company said, resulted in a signed agreement to settle these amounts due the company for $18.9 million.
"It is now evident to the company, however, through recent comments in the local press, that payment has been blocked," PHP said.
PHP said it remains committed to pursuing its contractual rights for the amounts it is due from the District.
PHP Healthcare currently operates more than 80 healthcare projects in 28 states.
